name: Vsp Official - Restricted Content Saver
description: Fast forwarder for restricted private and public Telegram channels

MONGO_DB.description: MongoDB connection URL. Get a free one at https://cloud.mongodb.com

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user id. For several, separate with spaces or commas

STRING.description: Optional. Pyrogram session string of a Telegram Premium account. Required only for uploads above 2GB

LOG_GROUP.description: Optional. Channel/group ID (with -100 prefix) used to stage files above 2GB. The bot must be admin there

FORCE_SUB.description: Optional. Channel ID (with -100 prefix) users must join. Leave 0 to disable

MASTER_KEY.description: Session encryption key (MASTER_KEY), generated for you. Changing it later forces every user to /login again

IV_KEY.description: Session encryption key (IV_KEY), generated for you. Changing it later forces every user to /login again

WORKERS.description: Posts transferred at once - the main speed lever, and close to linear. RAM is capped by TRANSFER_MEMORY_MB, so the limit is disk: each one holds a whole file on the dyno’s ~1GB. 8-12 for PDFs and clips, 2-3 for multi-GB videos

BATCH_DELAY.description: Seconds to wait between two posts of a batch. 0 is fastest

BATCH_LIMIT.description: Maximum posts allowed in one /batch run

JOIN_LINK.description: Optional updates channel link shown on /start

TURBO_STREAMS.description: Connections opened per file by the turbo engine. Main speed lever; 8-24, lower it if you hit FloodWait

TRANSFER_MEMORY_MB.description: Ceiling on file data held in RAM across all transfers. 192 suits a 512MB dyno
